segment.source: Simulate evolution with agents that search for food, reproduce and pass on mutating genes. Inspect individual agents and analyze population and gene distribution in charts.
segment.target: Jil isbeddelka noolayaasha cunto raadsada, tarma oo gudbiya hidde-sideyaal is beddela. Eeg noolayaasha gaarka ah, kuna falanqee tiradooda iyo qaybinta hidde-sideyaasha jaantusyo.
